newsitem.title: USA: TAT Tech sells 8 pct Telegate stake.
newsitem.headline: TAT Tech sells 8 pct Telegate stake.

text.p: TAT Technologies Ltd said Monday it sold 58,253 shares it held in Telegate Ltd for $1.6 million.
The shares sold represented about 8.0 percent of the issued and outstanding shares of Telegate, and the transaction will mean a capital gain of $900,000, TAT said in an announcement from Tel Aviv.
The deal is subject to approval by Telegate's shareholders, it said.

It said two of Telegate's shareholders and an unidentified investor exercised their right of first refusal and bought the shares from TAT. One of the shareholders was Aryt Industries Ltd, which is its affiliate, it said.
TAT and its subsidiaries make and repair heat transfer equipment used in aircraft, defense systems, electronic equipment and other applications.
